sections.title: Front matter

summary.text: Provides the introductory header and disclaimer for WHO's December 2025 Summary Table 1 on routine immunization recommendations, directing readers to the WHO position papers webpage and noting that cited ages and intervals guide national schedule development rather than direct clinical use.

sections.extract: Refer to https://www.who.int/teams/immunization-vaccines-and-biologicals/policies/position-papers for latest position paper updates. This table summarizes the WHO vaccination recommendations for children. The ages/intervals cited are to assist the development of country specific schedules and are not for direct use by health workers. sections.title: Table 1: Summary of WHO Position Papers – Recommendations for Routine Immunization

summary.text: Presents the first part of WHO Summary Table 1 (updated December 2025), summarizing routine immunization recommendations across children, adolescents, and adults for universally recommended antigens: RSV (maternal vaccine or long-acting monoclonal antibody), BCG, Hepatitis B, Polio, DTP-containing vaccine, Haemophilus influenzae type b (Hib), Pneumococcal conjugate vaccine (PCV), Rotavirus, Measles, Rubella, and HPV.

summary.text: Presents the remainder of WHO Summary Table 1 (updated December 2025) covering regional, high-risk, and programme-specific antigens—Japanese Encephalitis, Yellow Fever, Tick-Borne Encephalitis, Typhoid, Cholera, Meningococcal, Hepatitis A, Rabies, Dengue (TAK-003), Malaria, Mumps, Seasonal Influenza, Varicella, and the off-label 1p+1 PCV schedule—followed by detailed antigen-by-antigen footnotes (1–24) summarizing the corresponding WHO position papers and SAGE updates.
